# Accordion

[All examples](../EXAMPLES.md) · [Bottom sheet →](bottom_sheet.md)

<img src="../gifs/accordion.gif" width="300" alt="Accordion">

Sections open and close with a smooth height animation, and the chevron turns with them.

Reanimated docs: [examples/accordion](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/examples/accordion)

## What to look at

- Each body is measured with `AnimatedView(onLayout:)`, then its visible height animates between 0 and that height.
- `useDerivedAnimation(0.0, () => withTiming(height.value * (isExpanded.value ? 1 : 0)))` is the Dart form of Reanimated's `useDerivedValue(() => withTiming(...))`.
- Toggling `isExpanded` is all a tap does. Nothing calls `setState`.

## Code

The screen comes first, then the components it uses. Shared helpers (`DemoPage`, `Section`, `Stage`, `Palette`, `Buttons`, `ChoiceChips`, `LabeledSlider`) live in `example_app/lib/src/common/` and only do layout.

### `lib/src/screens/accordion_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';
import '../components/accordion_entry.dart';

/// examples/accordion: sections open and close with a smooth height
/// animation; the chevron turns with them.
class AccordionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AccordionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AccordionScreen> createState() => _AccordionScreenState();
}

class _AccordionScreenState extends State<AccordionScreen> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  static const entries = [
    ('What is Reanimated?',
        'A library for smooth animations and interactions that run at the '
            'display\'s frame rate. Shared values hold the state; animated styles '
            'read it; nothing else re-renders.'),
    ('How does this accordion work?',
        'The body is laid out at its natural height and measured. Its visible '
            'height is a derived value: withTiming(height × isExpanded). Toggling '
            'isExpanded animates it.'),
    ('Can several be open at once?',
        'Yes. Each item has its own isExpanded shared value. Try opening all '
            'three, then closing them in a different order: each animation '
            'continues from wherever the previous one left off.'),
  ];

  late final expanded = [for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) useSharedValue(i == 0)];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DemoPage(
        title: 'Accordion',
        docs: 'examples/accordion',
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)
              AccordionEntry(title: entries[i].$1, body: entries[i].$2, isExpanded: expanded[i]),
          ],
        ),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/components/accordion_entry.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';
import 'accordion_item.dart';

/// One accordion section: a header that toggles [isExpanded] and turns its
/// chevron, over an [AccordionItem] body.
class AccordionEntry extends StatefulWidget {
  const AccordionEntry({super.key, required this.title, required this.body, required this.isExpanded});
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final SharedValue<bool> isExpanded;

  @override
  State<AccordionEntry> createState() => _AccordionEntryState();
}

class _AccordionEntryState extends State<AccordionEntry> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final chevron = useDerivedAnimation(
    0.0,
    () => withTiming(widget.isExpanded.value ? math.pi : 0.0, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500)),
  );
  late final chevronStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(rotate: chevron.value));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Palette.grey, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => widget.isExpanded.value = !widget.isExpanded.value,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Row(children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(widget.title, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  ),
                  AnimatedView(
                    style: chevronStyle,
                    child: const Icon(Icons.expand_more, color: Palette.navy),
                  ),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
            AccordionItem(
              isExpanded: widget.isExpanded,
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 16),
                child: Text(widget.body, style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF4A4F63))),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/components/accordion_item.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

/// The Reanimated site's `AccordionItem`: the body's natural height is
/// measured, and the visible height animates between 0 and it with
/// withTiming whenever [isExpanded] changes. No React-style re-render: only
/// the shared values change.
class AccordionItem extends StatefulWidget {
  const AccordionItem({
    super.key,
    required this.isExpanded,
    required this.child,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
  });

  final SharedValue<bool> isExpanded;
  final Widget child;
  final Duration duration;

  @override
  State<AccordionItem> createState() => _AccordionItemState();
}

class _AccordionItemState extends State<AccordionItem> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final height = useSharedValue(0.0);

  // The Reanimated original is:
  //   useDerivedValue(() => withTiming(height.value * Number(isExpanded.value), { duration }))
  // The visible height animates to the measured height when expanded, or to 0.
  late final derivedHeight = useDerivedAnimation(
    0.0,
    () => withTiming(
      height.value * (widget.isExpanded.value ? 1 : 0),
      duration: widget.duration,
    ),
  );

  late final bodyStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(height: derivedHeight.value));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedView(
        style: bodyStyle,
        child: ClipRect(
          child: Stack(
            clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge,
            children: [
              // Laid out at its natural height whatever the visible height.
              Positioned(
                top: 0,
                left: 0,
                right: 0,
                child: AnimatedView(
                  onLayout: (size) => height.value = size.height,
                  child: widget.child,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
}
```
